concerns: 18. 共 → とも: This reading is for the kanji 共 when it stands alone or is part of a different compound. In the context of 共食い (ともぐい), 共 is read as とも. The provided reading `とも` is correct for the kanji 共 in this context.

19. 食 → く: This reading is for the kanji 食 when it stands alone or is part of a different compound. In the context of 共食い (ともぐい), 食 is read as ぐい (from くい, with rendaku). The provided reading `く` is correct for the kanji 食 in this context.
